result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Shape the future of perioperative nursing by inspiring, mentoring and educating the next generation.

Employment Type: Temporary Part Time Until July 2027
Position Classification: Clinical Nurse Educator
Remuneration: $62.67 - $64.70 per hour + Salary Packaging + 12% Superannuation 
Hours Per Week: 19
Requisition ID: REQ674436
Located in: Manning Hospital 
Closing Date: Monday 10th August 2026

Tentative interview date 13th - 14th August 

 

About the Opportunity

Are you an experienced perioperative nurse ready to take the next step in your career? This is an exciting opportunity to transition into education while remaining hands-on in the clinical environment and making a lasting impact on the development of the perioperative workforce. As a Clinical Nurse Educator - Perioperative (Instrument-Circulating), you'll join a dynamic and supportive team where you'll play a key role in developing the knowledge, skills and confidence of nurses across the perioperative service. Whether you're an experienced educator or an accomplished Instrument-Circulating Nurse looking to move into education, you'll be supported to grow your leadership and education capabilities while helping shape the future of perioperative nursing. You'll be supported by an experienced perioperative leadership team and work alongside dedicated Nurse Managers, Clinical Nurse Specialists and fellow educators who are committed to your success. You'll have access to ongoing professional development, education opportunities and mentoring to further develop your skills in clinical education and leadership while helping to build a confident, capable and highly skilled perioperative workforce.

What You Will Be Doing

As the Clinical Nurse Educator, you will provide clinical education, mentorship and support to nursing staff across the perioperative environment, with a strong focus on Instrument and Circulating practice.

In this role, you will:

Deliver education and competency-based training to perioperative nursing staff.

Provide one-on-one, "elbow-to-elbow" clinical support for novice and junior nurses in the operating theatre.

Facilitate orientation, clinical assessments and ongoing professional development.

Identify learning needs and implement evidence-based education strategies to build clinical capability.

Promote best practice, patient safety and continuous quality improvement across the perioperative service.

Work collaboratively with Nurse Managers, Clinical Nurse Specialists and the multidisciplinary team to foster a positive learning culture.

About you

Our ideal candidate is an experienced Instrument-Circulating Registered Nurse with a passion for education and supporting others to succeed. You enjoy sharing your knowledge, building confidence in less experienced staff and creating a positive learning environment. You lead by example, communicate effectively and are committed to delivering safe, high-quality perioperative care.

You will bring:

Extensive experience as an Instrument-Circulating Registered Nurse within a perioperative environment.

A collaborative approach and the ability to build positive working relationships across multidisciplinary teams.

A passion for mentoring, coaching and developing the perioperative workforce.

Strong communication, organisation and interpersonal skills.
